ownerReports.source: Owner chat reports in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-25 ("backend should be ready", "yes we also have the tables now!", test accounts "done" and "should be fixed now").
ownerReports.summary: The owner created the Supabase development project cvc-helper-dev (West EU), ran the course-backup migration (13 tables with row-level security), created powersync_role, created the PowerSync Cloud project CVC Helper with a CLI token, and two synthetic test accounts; all values are in the ignored .env. Chose email magic-link sign-in. The agent verified each value's shape without printing it, linked and deployed the Development instance (EU), and confirmed replication of all 13 tables and both test sign-ins.
